techs.name: Kintsugi Mend
techs.notes: Ending 3 (Ch12). Restores HP and max-HP ceiling with a gold fill. On Crono: +2 integrity once per battle; can mend a PEAK crack.

techs.name: Porcelain Memory
techs.notes: Ending 3 (Ch12). Shape: copies the last party shape used (written as SINGLE until the engine supports shape copying). Adds the weakness tag he is holding to everything it touches.

techs.name: Null Spoon HOLD
techs.notes: Ending 3 (Ch12). 0.1 power (no damage). He steadies the spoon instead of swinging it: places a weakness tag he has learned on the target for 2 turns. It counts as real for shaving and for the 2.0x multiplier.
